integrity: Analytical proof for complete quantified domain, supplementing numerical tests; no independent mathematical validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only real two-dimensional pointed solid closed convex cones; 1<p<infinity; endpoint norms, degenerate cones and higher dimension are excluded. Residual risk of an equivalent earlier planar result.
title: Sharp Lipschitz constants and nonexpansivity for every planar \(\ell_p\) cone
